mapper.select: select count(1) from exam where id=#{examId}

select r.id record_id,e.id exam_id,s.id student_id,s.student_name,s.student_phone, coalesce(r.status,'NOT_STARTED') record_status,r.grading_status,r.score,r.start_time,r.deadline_time,r.submit_time from exam e inner join student s on s.class_id=e.class_id and s.status='ACTIVE' left join student_exam_record r on r.exam_id=e.id and r.student_id=s.id where e.id=#{examId} union all select r.id record_id,e.id exam_id,s.id student_id,s.student_name,s.student_phone, r.status record_status,r.grading_status,r.score,r.start_time,r.deadline_time,r.submit_time from exam e inner join student_exam_record r on r.exam_id=e.id inner join student s on s.id=r.student_id where e.id=#{examId} and (s.status!='ACTIVE' or s.class_id is null or s.class_id!=e.class_id) order by submit_time desc,student_id

select r.id record_id,r.exam_id,e.paper_id,p.paper_name,c.class_period,p.stage_name,r.student_id, s.student_name,s.student_phone,p.total_score,r.score,r.status record_status,r.grading_status, r.start_time,r.deadline_time,r.submit_time from student_exam_record r inner join exam e on e.id=r.exam_id inner join exam_paper p on p.id=e.paper_id inner join sys_class c on c.id=e.class_id inner join student s on s.id=r.student_id where r.id=#{recordId}

select a.id answer_id,a.question_id,cast(q.question_content as char) question_content,a.question_type,a.question_score, cast(a.answer_content as char) answer_content,cast(q.answer_content as char) correct_answer, cast(q.analysis_content as char) analysis_content,a.correct,a.score from student_exam_answer a inner join exam_question q on q.id=a.question_id where a.record_id=#{recordId} order by a.id
select id,question_id,option_key,cast(option_content as char) option_content from exam_question_option where question_id=#{questionId} order by sort_order,id
mapper.update: update student_exam_answer set score=#{score},updated_at=now() where id=#{answerId} and record_id=#{recordId} and question_type in ('FILL','SHORT','PROGRAMMING') and #{score} <= question_score
mapper.select: select count(1) from student_exam_answer where record_id=#{recordId} and score is null
select coalesce(sum(score),0) from student_exam_answer where record_id=#{recordId}
mapper.update: update student_exam_record set score=#{score},grading_status=#{gradingStatus},updated_at=now() where id=#{recordId} and status='SUBMITTED'
